newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar weak on poor demand, limited activity.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar weak on poor demand, limited activity.

text.p: Sugar prices remained weak on the local market on Friday, dealers said.
Consumer demand and enquiries from retailers were low and sentiments were subdued amid limited activity.
"Arrivals too remained at low ebb as most of the delivery tenders out of the free sale quota for current month are already exhausted," one dealer said.

Meanwhile in ready delivery sugar S-30 slid by five rupees to 1,220/1,260 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell by the same margin at 1,260/1,355 rupees. Sugar mill delivery for the first week of February was quoted at 1,170/1,185 rupees per quintal.
Free sale quota for February is higher by 50,000 tonnes to 700,000 tonnes against 650,000 tonnes released in January.
